name: implied-volatility-context-2026-10-25
hypothesis: Lagged broad option-implied volatility level/change may condition trading decisions differently from own-price or realized-market-price features. Test information versus same-size masked and original legacy controls; no benefit is assumed.
availability: Exact prior and21st-prior XNYS closes, assumed available following XNYS close+15minutes; require UTC decision at/after availability, no stale fill. Current-vintage Yahoo, historical original publication/vintages unverified.
source_limitation: Retrospective111-symbol survivor training panel, original26-symbol repeated2021-23 development; no point-in-time membership/delisting proof or independent prospective result.

normalization.full: Fit only2new coordinates on298946training rows; no development fitting
normalization.masked: Two extra raw fields/means zero, scales one; original seven unchanged

sampling.group_rule: Choose ETF with probability4/26 and stock with probability22/26, independent of history/outcomes; then sample each group from a seeded shuffled episode deck without replacement until exhausted; uniformly choose a full512-transition window
sampling.episode_cycle: Shuffle each group again only after every member was drawn; no return/regime ranking
sampling.actual_logging: Per-symbol starts/transitions, group starts/transitions, dataset and normalization identities; report actual ETF mass, not just intended probability
sampling.budget_justification: Same accepted111-symbol history, group/deck/window sampler and100k steps per arm. Only the two lagged VIX coordinates differ between23-input full/masked policies; the original21-input legacy arm controls input-dimension effects.

shared_initialization.legacy: Exact pinned original full64 untrained tensors and original per-seed CPU sampling RNG, also for smoke
shared_initialization.augmented: 23inputs. Copy all common tensors; LSTM input columns0:7 unchanged, original7:21 into9:23; set new columns7:9 to exact zero in actor and critic. Full/masked entire policies/empty optimizers identical. Restore original CPU RNG, verify NumPy/Python seeded states equal before learning.
shared_initialization.generation: No dataset/provider or optimizer steps; immutable checksummed NPZ/manifest in tracked configs before upload.
shared_initialization.limitation: No bitwise21-versus23 floating-point trajectory promise; historical legacy reproduction is independently required.

historical_control_reproduction.failure: Invalidate interpretation and promotion without widened tolerances or automatic retry.

screen_gate.failure: Close this fixed two-coordinate VIX family; no level/change/window/feed/normalization/model/reward/steps grid, extension, confirmation or promotion.

confirmation_gate.interpretation: Development gates only; a frozen prospective comparison remains required

selection_metric: Unchanged equal-weight mean26-symbol development net return, selected and actual final post-update independently. Final test cannot select checkpoints.
smoke_acceptance: Inspect actual Colab Python before dependency sync; verify actual shared/mapped tensors and RNG, exact masks/recurrent-state/frozen prediction parity for at least78 predictions per arm, optimizer restoration, dataset/normalizer/execution/sampling/report identity, and smoke-backed deadline projection before screens.
short_side: Report long/short net PnL and costs; future declining-stock labels reporting-only. Require both positive total and positive net short PnL for profitable-short claims.

execution.concurrency: Configurable central fleet, aggregate minute metering; same original project ledger/lock, persistent vix-study baseline across smoke/screen/retries.
execution.cleanup: Retain/retrieve durably; verify every owned shutdown and release hash before duplicate cleanup; never stop unrelated sessions.

constraints: Optional family only; no source2024+ prices, retired-test reuse, source-outcome selection, broker orders, reward/cost/holding/action changes or reopening failed families. Coverage alone is not a model win; only fixed multi-seed development plus prospective evidence can support the objective.
